facts.fact: The Government of Mauritius hosted the SADC Capacity Building Workshop on Cyber Security and the first SADC Regional Cyber Drill at Ebene on 10-13 September 2018, attended by delegates from fourteen SADC member states, with the SADC ICT Implementing Agency and CRASA.
